licence_note: Templates, theses, slide decks, posters, CVs, letters, exams and journal samples shipped in TeX Live 2026 (texmf-dist/doc), each under its package's own licence (mostly LPPL). They are copied from the local TeX Live installation into the cache; nothing is committed. `sha256` pins the exact file; a different TeX Live release is reported as a mismatch.
selection: Lane PARITY-HUNT (kabir-claude-parityhunt), 2026-11-01, from MacTeX 2026's texmf-dist: every package directory under doc/latex whose name matches thesis|these|dissert|beamertheme|beamerposter|poster|(^|-)cv|cv$|letter|exam|aastex|mnras|revtex|elsarticle|acmart|ieeetran|llncs|ametsoc|tufte|memoir|koma|kaobook|lecture|book|aa$|copernicus|jss|amsart|amscls|sigplan|nature|iopart|achemso|biochem|apa|rsc|svjour|powerdot|prosper|seminar|leaflet|flyer|scrjrnl|novel|report|article|template (case-insensitive); in each, the .tex files of at most 200 kB with \documentclass and \begin{document} outside comments, that load none of fontspec, unicode-math, xeCJK, luatexja, ctex or polyglossia, use no ctex/ltj class and have no `% !TEX program = xe/lua` line, and that are not already a templates, packages or beamer entry; sorted by (name has sample|example|demo|template|test|main|thesis|skeleton|minimal first, path depth, path) and the first 2 kept. Each copies its whole directory (copy_dir). Files pdflatex itself cannot compile are excluded by the oracle at run time, not here.
